title: Lean formalization
headline: Lean 4, 0 sorry, standard axioms: eight claims (Kimura k = mu and fixation probability, Fisher FTNS, Maynard Smith twofold cost, Thompson's cube law, flight power ch02-06, the size limit for flight ch02-07, speed proportional to the square root of size ch02-10) and five extensions (favored fixation floor, blueprint well-formedness, area law, strength law, bending law) (fixation >= i/M when selection does not oppose a mutant; well-formedness of a generated anatomical blueprint). 92 theorems, 53 lemmas; 26 of 26 statement or data mutants rejected, 11/11 controls. NEW: a kernel-checked certificate for the organism thread's flying-fish blueprint: 536 distinct terms, 674 part_of edges, acyclic, every term reaches the body root, 1390 never_in_taxon and 5435 in_taxon statements pinned from Ubergraph exclude nothing, distinct counts per level body 1, organ_system 13, organ 67, tissue 198, cell 257 (the placement-vs-term count the organism thread fixed by hand). Structural only: it does not say the fish is real or the ontology right. Thompson's cube law has a formal statement (exact exponent 3) beside the claims thread's measured exponents (2.74-2.86 on age-bin means; 2.10 to 3.10 by age window). Flying-fish substitution budget still inconclusive. 33 unsigned nanopub drafts pass np check + parse + Delphi lint; no human named; nothing signed or published. Scaling laws R2-R9 from the physics thread are proved in lean/Delphi/Scaling.lean with every contested quantity a named hypothesis: strength and bending complete Galileo's square-cube argument, so 28 constraints rule; on the enumerator's 44 candidates the verdicts are 2 eliminated (both proposed-here), 19 consistent, 23 cannot-rule, and WP-077/C1 (leaf bending) is consistent under the body-like-load reading as the physics thread predicted; nothing in the square-cube rows is eliminated because they restate the laws. Illustrative eliminations: a giant claimed to stand, a glider below its minimum speed, a constant-thickness leaf that still claims a bending limit. AUDIT (Amit's direction): every one of the 92 theorems checked against the real flying fish (lean/AUDIT-FLYING-FISH.md): 19 hold when instantiated (the blueprint certificate, the exact minimum-speed bound on the Park and Choi specimen with v_min 9.85 m/s against field speeds 10-20 m/s, the cube law approximately at Davenport's 2.981), 6 have their isometry hypotheses violated by measured within-species exponents (fin area 1.834, wing loading 1.236), 67 cannot be evaluated for want of a named input (no mutation rate, fixation probability, fitness variance, material strength, muscle power or second body size is measured for Exocoetidae). Morphology grounding for all 110 pieces of the 3D model (lean/morphology-grounding.json): wing size is bounded by the minimum-speed theorem (lifting area needed 0.0123 m^2 at 10 m/s against 0.0127 m^2 measured), fin rays and skeleton reach the strength and bending lemmas with inputs missing, organs are grounded only structurally through the certified blueprint, and eyes and the dorsal and anal fins are reached by no theorem.
